title: Sordland/Turn01/Start_Inauguration
description: The Inauguration crowns the player as the President of Sordland. It sums up the prologue and sets the ground for Chapter I

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the distance, the Maroon Palace..."
entries.dialogueText: In the distance, the Maroon Palace stood on top of the famous Hill of Pride. I had no way of knowing what future awaited me there.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at my family. My son and d..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at my family. My son and daughter, Franc and Deana, were next to Monica, my wife. Her eyes were glimmering with pride.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As my thoughts slowly faded away, t..."
entries.dialogueText: As my thoughts slowly faded away, the reality of the situation dawned on me. Orso Hawker, the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, was waiting for me.

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: "“The time for the oath has come.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The time for the oath has come.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am ready.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am ready.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It has indeed.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It has indeed.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let’s start.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let’s start.”

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: "“Please repeat after me. I do solem..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please repeat after me. I do solemnly swear...”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I do solemnly swear that I will re..."
entries.dialogueText: “I do solemnly swear that I will respectfully execute the office of the President of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: "“And to the best of my ability, pre..."
entries.dialogueText: “And to the best of my ability, preserve, protect and defend...”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“And to the best of my ability, pre..."
entries.dialogueText: “And to the best of my ability, preserve, protect and defend the people and the constitution of the Republic of Sordland.”
entries.menuText: “And to the best of my ability, preserve, protect and defend...”

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
entries.title: Orso Hawker: "“You may now deliver your inaugurat..."
entries.dialogueText: “You may now deliver your inauguration speech, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you, Mr. Hawker.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. Hawker.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It is an honor, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It is an honor, sir.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good, let's begin.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good, let's begin.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Dear citizens of Sordland!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Dear citizens of Sordland!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd looked very eager to list..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd looked very eager to listen to me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“For many generations, this country..."
entries.dialogueText: “For many generations, this country and its long history have kept us tied to an idea – the idea of unity, and our people’s right for a free and prosperous life.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are enduring economic hardship..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are enduring economic hardship like never before, and today, our nation is falling apart. Our people – we –suffer in this dire situation.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You, the people, have chosen. Toge..."
entries.dialogueText: “You, the people, have chosen. Together, we will bring prosperity and reform to our nation. It is a time of hope, it is a time of change.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It is time for a united and powerf..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is time for a united and powerful Sordland once again!”
entries.menuText: “It is time for a united and powerful Sordland once again!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Change now, not in the next decade..."
entries.dialogueText: “Change now, not in the next decade or years. Today!”
entries.menuText: “Change now, not in the next decade, or years. Today!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our capacity as a nation has never..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our capacity as a nation has never been greater!”
entries.menuText: “Our capacity as a nation has never been greater!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hundreds of thousands cheered. They..."
entries.dialogueText: Hundreds of thousands cheered. They were shouting my name in unison. I felt the responsibility, the power and the burden all at the same time.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nice to meet you, Serge.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Nice to meet you, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's a pleasure.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's a pleasure.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“It's an honor.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's an honor.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“The pleasure is all but mine.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The pleasure is all but mine.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The motorcade began to move. On the..."
entries.dialogueText: The motorcade began to move. On the way, Serge proceeded to explain his duties as a driver.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Every time I look at it, I am remi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Every time I look at it, I am reminded of my duty to this nation.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So do I, Serge. It is the beating..."
entries.dialogueText: “So do I, Serge. It is the beating heart of the nation after all.”
entries.menuText: “So do I, Serge. It is the beating heart of the nation after all.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We all owe a great debt to the men..."
entries.dialogueText: “We all owe a great debt to the men who led the country from here.”
entries.menuText: “We all owe a great debt to the men who led the country from here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It is in good hands now.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It is in good hands now.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I am sure of that, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am sure of that, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Well said, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well said, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Their service will not be forgotte..."
entries.dialogueText: “Their service will not be forgotten.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The car drove past the majestic gat..."
entries.dialogueText: The car drove past the majestic gates, continued uphill to the entrance and stopped in front of the doors.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Have a great day, Mr. President. A..."
entries.dialogueText: “Have a great day, Mr. President. A Morgna wes core.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Goodbye.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“See you soon.”"
entries.dialogueText: “See you soon.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I made my way upstairs through the..."
entries.dialogueText: I made my way upstairs through the extravagant corridors of the palace. Marble and engraved wooden finishes decorated the interior.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Hello, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hello, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“If you'll allow me to introduce my..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you'll allow me to introduce myself, I am Serge, your new driver.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“We will be heading towards the pal..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will be heading towards the palace.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Isn't it a beauty? The Maroon Pala..."
entries.dialogueText: “Isn't it a beauty? The Maroon Palace.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“In the past, there have been times..."
entries.dialogueText: “In the past, there have been times of survival – times of conflict and economic hardship too – but whenever we stood together, we prevailed.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We still have insufficient infrast..."
entries.dialogueText: “We still have insufficient infrastructure – houses without electricity, without water. We have crime in our streets, unemployment within the youth, and we still have injustices in the government that plague us.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Our workers are no less productive..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our workers are no less productive than a decade ago. Our capable minds are no less inventive, our products and services no less requested than they were last week, last month, or last year.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I still felt euphoric from the afte..."
entries.dialogueText: I still felt euphoric from the aftermath of my speech. Hearing my new title made me smile even more.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a long look at the people of..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a long look at the people of Sordland to burn this moment into my memory.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The presidential state car was a je..."
entries.dialogueText: The presidential state car was a jet black Kadilla with flags of Sordland above the front headlights. Next to it, a man was holding the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As minutes passed by, I found mysel..."
entries.dialogueText: As minutes passed by, I found myself lost in thought again, barely paying attention to what he was saying. He suddenly gestured out the window.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was right. Sunlight glinted off..."
entries.dialogueText: He was right. Sunlight glinted off the palace's many maroon-coloured domes. It was so bright that I had to look away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge got out of the car and opened..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge got out of the car and opened the door for me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Then I turned towards the key peopl..."
entries.dialogueText: Then I turned towards the key people who made it all possible. Of course, each individual was promised an important position in my government.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Two weeks had passed since we won t..."
entries.dialogueText: Two weeks had passed since we won the election.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And now I was about to be sworn in..."
entries.dialogueText: And now I was about to be sworn in as the 4th President of Sordland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Thousands were watching the inaugur..."
entries.dialogueText: Thousands were watching the inauguration ceremony and cheering my name: Anton Rayne.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“At ease, Serge.”"
entries.dialogueText: “At ease, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“As you wish, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As you wish, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of the presidential guards came..."
entries.dialogueText: One of the presidential guards came by to notify me that it was time to leave. I made my way to the leading car in the motorcade.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He respectfully bowed his head befo..."
entries.dialogueText: He respectfully bowed his head before opening the car door and gesturing inside. I entered the car.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's just a building, Serge.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's just a building, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“You are right, Mr. President. I do..."
entries.dialogueText: “You are right, Mr. President. I don't know much about architecture, but for me, it's the most beautiful building in all of Holsord.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He referred to the famous Sordish p..."
entries.dialogueText: He referred to the famous Sordish phrase from the times of revolution; "A Morgna wes core, Vectern sis da!" which meant "Morning will come, Victory is close."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Vectern sis da!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Vectern sis da!”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "The die was cast and there my story..."
entries.dialogueText: The die was cast and there my story began.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I raised my fist in the air, which..."
entries.dialogueText: I raised my fist in the air, which triggered a huge burst of applause.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I waved at the crowd, which made th..."
entries.dialogueText: I waved at the crowd, which made the people cheer louder.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Taking a deep breath in, I enjoyed..."
entries.dialogueText: Taking a deep breath in, I enjoyed the moment.

entries.speaker: Orso Hawker
Player
entries.title: Player: "“Brothers and sisters!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Brothers and sisters!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My fellow Sords!”"
entries.dialogueText: “My fellow Sords!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I promise you, we *will* stop the..."
entries.dialogueText: “I promise you, we *will* stop the recession and eliminate poverty!”
entries.menuText: “I promise you, we *will* stop the recession and eliminate poverty!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The future awaits us! It's time to..."
entries.dialogueText: “The future awaits us! It's time to turn our faces to the east!”
entries.menuText: “The future awaits us! It's time to turn our faces to the east!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The future awaits us! It's time to..."
entries.dialogueText: “The future awaits us! It's time to turn our faces to the west!”
entries.menuText: “The future awaits us! It's time to turn our faces to the west!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“First, we must rewrite our broken..."
entries.dialogueText: “First, we must rewrite our broken Constitution from 1929!”
entries.menuText: “First, we must rewrite our broken Constitution from 1929!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The future awaits us! Sordland is..."
entries.dialogueText: “The future awaits us! Sordland is above all in the world!”
entries.menuText: “The future awaits us! Sordland is above all in the world!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw my previous rival and former..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw my previous rival and former president, Ewald Alphonso, who gave me a slight nod. Tarquin Soll was also invited, but as expected, he didn’t leave his island retreat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw my previous rival and former..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw my previous rival and former president, Ewald Alphonso. Tarquin Soll was also invited, but as expected, he didn’t leave his island retreat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw my previous rival and former..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw my previous rival and former president, Ewald Alphonso. Tarquin Soll was also invited, but as expected, he didn't leave his island retreat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My footsteps echoed in the colossal..."
entries.dialogueText: My footsteps echoed in the colossal halls. The guards bowed their heads in respect as I opened the massive doors to my new office.
